criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 24 March 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 24 September 2029 (36 months after Closing).

Identifies the threatened $450,000 claim by Northgate Robotics Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Calculates the long-stop date as 20 November 2026 (90 days after signing on 22 August 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 4 January 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Penrith Engineering Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (24 March 2028; 24 September 2029) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 1 September 2026 (570 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
